units.source_text: 人们以为这车子将驱往附近某处，岂知一直向宇治去了。

en.t: People thought the carriage would be driven somewhere nearby, but instead it went straight on to Uji.

units.source_text: 途中调换用的牛早已准备。

en.t: Oxen for changing teams along the way had already been prepared.

units.source_text: 经过川原，到了法性寺附近，天色方始大明。

en.t: After passing Kawara and reaching the area near Hosshoji, the sky at last grew fully bright.

units.source_text: 那个侍从偷窥薰大将的容姿，觉得俊美无比，不胜恋慕之情，便把世人对此事如何评议等事都忘记了。

en.t: That lady-in-waiting stole glances at General Kaoru's figure, found him surpassingly handsome, and was so overcome with longing that she forgot all about how people might judge the affair.

units.source_text: 浮舟则因此事过分唐突，吓得神志昏迷，只管俯伏车中。

en.t: Ukifune, meanwhile, was terrified by the sheer suddenness of it all, nearly faint with shock, and simply lay face down inside the carriage.

units.source_text: 薰大将对她说：“这一带地方路上石子高低不平，你觉得不舒服么？”

en.t: General Kaoru said to her, "The stones on the road around here are uneven. Are you uncomfortable?"
Then he took her up onto his lap.

units.source_text: 车子前面遮着一件轻罗女袍，鲜明的朝阳光辉射入车中，照得老尼姑弁君害羞。

en.t: A light gauze woman's robe hung as a screen at the front of the carriage, and the vivid morning sunlight streamed inside, making the old nun Ben no Kimi feel embarrassed.

units.source_text: 她想：“安得大小姐在世，让我伴她做此旅行！

en.t: She thought, "If only the elder princess were alive, so that I could accompany her on such a journey!

units.source_text: 可恨我身长生在世，遭逢此种意外之变。”

en.t: How bitter it is that I have lived on so long, only to meet with such an unexpected turn of events."

units.source_text: 她心中悲伤，努力隐忍，然而不知不觉地愁形于面，泪下沾襟。

en.t: She grieved inwardly and tried hard to restrain herself, but before she knew it sorrow showed on her face and tears fell, wetting her collar.

units.source_text: 侍从看了颇感不快，想道：“这婆子真讨厌啊！

en.t: Seeing this, the lady-in-waiting felt quite displeased and thought, "This old woman is truly tiresome!

units.source_text: 今天小姐新婚，车子里带个尼姑已经不吉祥了，为什么还要愁眉苦脸，啼啼哭哭呢！”

en.t: Today is my lady's wedding day, and it is unlucky enough to have a nun riding in the carriage. Why must she still look so gloomy and keep weeping?"

units.source_text: 她觉得此人可恨亦复可笑。

en.t: She found the woman both detestable and ridiculous.

units.source_text: 原来侍从不知弁君心事，只当作老太婆爱哭。

en.t: In fact, the lady-in-waiting did not know what was in Ben no Kimi's heart and merely took her for an old woman who loved to cry.
